summary: OpnForm is an open-source tool designed to create and manage web forms for polls, events, and data collection. It provides a self-hosted interface to build and deploy custom input forms without relying on third-party SaaS providers.
goodFor: It suits teams or individuals who want to keep form submission data on their own infrastructure while avoiding monthly subscription fees.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence places strong copyleft requirements on your modifications, which may complicate usage if you plan to integrate it into proprietary internal services.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based deployment utilising PHP and Node.js, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your database and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
